_comment: Firm baseline for structured note review. Deviations from these values trigger compare_baseline flagging.

BarrierLogic._note_barrier: Barrier levels below 60% of starting value require senior analyst sign-off

CouponStructure._note_memory: Memory feature preferred — notes without memory require justification for contingent coupon structures

RiskParameters._note_principal: Principal at risk is acceptable but must be explicitly documented in the Downside section

CallLogic._note_settlement: Settlement lag > 5 business days requires operations review
